releaseBlockers.title: Currency is lost between catalog and payment
releaseBlockers.evidence: Products and product DTOs carry CurrencyType, but cart/order DTOs and Orders do not. CartService and CheckoutService sum raw prices, while ZarinpalGatewayService always sends the raw amount with currency IRT.
releaseBlockers.impact: Rial products can be mislabeled or charged at the wrong magnitude and mixed-currency carts produce invalid totals.
releaseBlockers.recommendation: Choose a canonical order currency, persist it on cart/order/payment snapshots, convert exactly once or prohibit mixed currencies, and format every UI from that value.

releaseBlockers.title: A paid order can be cancelled without refund
releaseBlockers.evidence: OrderService.CancelOrderAsync blocks completed, already-cancelled, and delivered orders but does not reject PaymentStatus.Paid, create a refund, or transition the Payment.
releaseBlockers.impact: An operator can leave captured customer money attached to a cancelled order with no refund record or customer-safe financial state.
releaseBlockers.recommendation: Either prohibit cancellation of paid orders until an explicit refund succeeds or implement one atomic cancel-and-refund workflow with audit history.

releaseBlockers.title: Production graph contains known vulnerable packages
releaseBlockers.evidence: dotnet list package --vulnerable reports transitive System.Text.Json 6.0.0 (high) and AngleSharp 0.17.1 (moderate) in Infrastructure/API.
releaseBlockers.impact: Known security defects remain in production-reachable parsing/sanitization dependencies.
releaseBlockers.recommendation: Upgrade the dependency chain to patched versions, remove obsolete constraints, and enforce advisory scanning in CI.

releaseBlockers.title: Database release artifact remains an unapproved schema candidate
releaseBlockers.evidence: Database documentation and manifest identify VitorizeDb.schema-candidate.dacpac as pending DBA/release-owner approval, although repeatable local publication and verification pass.
releaseBlockers.impact: The production schema baseline and rollback authority are not formally established.
releaseBlockers.recommendation: Approve and freeze the DACPAC/manifest checksum after a production-like upgrade and rollback review.

releaseBlockers.title: Live payment configuration is not fail-fast or provider-certified
releaseBlockers.evidence: ZarinpalSandbox is seeded/documented but never read; sandbox URL defaults remain in the service; payment health reads nonexistent ZarinpalIsSandbox; real provider execution was unavailable.
releaseBlockers.impact: Production can silently target the wrong environment or fail only when a customer pays; callback and amount behavior is unproven.
releaseBlockers.recommendation: Use one authoritative gateway mode, validate merchant/base/start/callback origins at startup, fix health checks, and certify a controlled live transaction.

releaseBlockers.title: Critical database and media restore is not proven
releaseBlockers.evidence: No automated SQL/public-media/private-KYC backup policy, RPO/RTO, or executed restore drill was found; documentation is checklist-level.
releaseBlockers.impact: A database/storage incident can permanently lose orders, balances, delivery evidence, KYC documents, or catalog media.
releaseBlockers.recommendation: Implement encrypted automated backups for SQL and both file roots, retention/monitoring, and record a successful isolated restore.

releaseBlockers.title: Production host durability and proxy contract is absent
releaseBlockers.evidence: No explicit Data Protection key persistence/share, forwarded-header middleware, shared media storage, distributed cache/backplane, or executed IIS/container restart/multi-instance plan exists.
releaseBlockers.impact: Cookies and antiforgery can break after ephemeral restart, client scheme/IP/canonical URLs can be wrong, and multiple instances can disagree on state/files.
releaseBlockers.recommendation: Document one supported topology and configure persistent/shared keys, trusted proxies, durable media, affinity/backplane as needed, then rehearse it.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Web token refresh and logout revocation are incomplete
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: ApiClient uses only the access token; Web logout signs out cookies and does not call API logout, leaving the rotating refresh token active.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Sessions fail abruptly at access-token expiry and stolen refresh tokens survive normal logout.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Add synchronized refresh/retry and revoke the server token before clearing cookies.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Refund and reconciliation operations have no Admin UI
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: AdminPaymentsController exposes refund and manual completion and PaymentService supports reconciliation, while Payments.razor is read-only plus CSV.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Operators must call APIs manually during customer-money incidents, increasing delay and error risk.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Expose guarded, confirmed refund/reconcile workflows with status, reference, reason and audit visibility.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Order can be completed before all items are fulfilled
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: CompleteOrderAsync checks paid/not-cancelled but does not require every manual/support item to be delivered or otherwise resolved.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Customer and operations can see a completed order with missing delivery.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Centralize transition rules and require all required fulfilment states before completion.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Automatic support tickets are hard-coded to GTA VI
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: PaymentService.CreateSupportTicketIfRequiredAsync sets Subject to a GTA VI string for every opted-in product.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Tickets for other products are mislabeled, harming routing and customer trust.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Generate the subject from the order item product/variant or a safe configurable template.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Auto-ticket uniqueness and multi-item semantics are incomplete
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: One-ticket behavior is query/lock based without a unique Tickets.OrderId constraint; any existing order ticket suppresses auto creation and only the first qualifying item is linked.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Multi-support orders or customer-created tickets can leave items unlinked or suppress required fulfilment.
dependencies: Business decision: ticket per order or item
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Define the aggregate rule, persist an auto-ticket discriminator/link model, and enforce the chosen uniqueness in SQL.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Catalog filters and TotalCount are incorrect across pages
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: Product type, instant-delivery and tier filters are applied in ShopBrowser after one server page; rating is absent and filter/page changes are not persisted in the URL.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Customers miss matching products, pagination lies, and filtered searches cannot be shared or restored.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Move all filters/sorts into one server query, return authoritative count, and bind state to the query string.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Cross-project visual regression is nondeterministic
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: The all-project visual run passed 1/6 and failed 5/6; an isolated desktop-light reset then passed 2/2. Home heights differed materially.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Responsive/dark regressions can be hidden by execution order or produce false release failures.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Isolate fixture/database state per project or reseed before each project and make time/dynamic sections deterministic.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: No checked-in CI quality gate
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: No .github workflow or equivalent pipeline definition was found despite local release scripts.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Build, test, advisory and database regressions depend on manual execution.
dependencies: CI runner with SQL Server and Chrome
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Run the repository gate on protected branches and retain immutable test artifacts.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Health checks are shallow and payment mode check is wrong
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: Public health only calls Database.CanConnect; protected details reads ZarinpalIsSandbox instead of seeded ZarinpalSandbox and no readiness/liveness endpoints are registered.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Orchestrators and operators cannot distinguish alive, ready, misconfigured, or degraded instances.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Use ASP.NET health checks with tagged liveness/readiness and safe configuration details.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Admin lists use capped client-side paging
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: Payments and several admin pages load up to 500 records then filter/page in the Blazor circuit.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Older records disappear and counts, exports, latency and memory degrade as the store grows.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Implement server-side paging/filter/sort and streaming or job-based exports.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Account assurance lacks email verification, 2FA and device controls
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: TwoFactorAuthentication purpose is rejected; no email verification or session/device list/revocation surface exists.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: High-value customer and admin accounts have weaker takeover resistance and self-service recovery.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Prioritize admin 2FA and refresh-session inventory, then customer assurance according to risk.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Address and privacy request workflows are absent
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: UserAddresses exists but no customer controller/page was found; no account deletion/export/data-request workflow or documented KYC retention policy exists.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Future address-requiring products and privacy obligations require manual database/operations work.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Define policy first, then expose owner-scoped address and auditable privacy-request workflows.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Delivery, refund and terms disclosures are incomplete
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: No checkout terms acknowledgement was found; generic instant-delivery trust copy can appear for manual/support items and refund/return notice is incomplete.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Customers may buy with inaccurate fulfilment expectations and weak evidence of accepted terms.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Render mode-specific expectations and persist the accepted terms/policy version on checkout.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Support operations lack assignment, SLA and controlled attachments
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: Ticket entity/page supports department/priority/status/replies/internal notes but no assignee/SLA; attachment DTO takes a path while current UI always sends null.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: Queues cannot establish ownership or lateness, and attachments are not a safe usable workflow.
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Model assignment/SLA and use an authenticated private attachment upload ID instead of a client-supplied path.

requiredAfterLaunch.title: Zero-price products cannot complete checkout
requiredAfterLaunch.evidence: Admin validation and E2E explicitly allow zero base price, while both PaymentService gateway and wallet paths reject FinalAmount <= 0.
requiredAfterLaunch.impact: A supported catalog state creates orders that cannot be completed.
requiredTests: No payment row or explicit zero payment
requiredAfterLaunch.recommendation: Either add an audited zero-total completion path or reject zero pricing consistently in Admin.

recommendedImprovements.title: Establish realistic query and latency budgets
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Current performance coverage checks one document/layout; product projections contain correlated inventory/review counts and no query-plan/p95 evidence exists.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Catalog growth can create slow SQL/API responses without an enforced signal.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Seed realistic volumes, capture SQL/query counts, and gate p95/error rate.

recommendedImprovements.title: Extend rate limiting beyond authentication
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Fixed-window policies cover login, OTP and registration but not checkout, payment, ticket or uploads.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Authenticated abuse can consume storage, provider calls, DB locks and operator capacity.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Add user/IP-aware limits to expensive endpoints and monitor rejections.

recommendedImprovements.title: Broaden accessibility gates and label icon buttons
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Shop filter removal and Persian date navigation buttons lack explicit names; axe gate ignores moderate findings.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Keyboard/screen-reader users receive ambiguous controls and some regressions are not gated.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Add aria-label/title text and expand the page/interaction accessibility matrix.

recommendedImprovements.title: Harden Content Security Policy
recommendedImprovements.evidence: CSP allows unsafe-inline scripts/styles and broad https/wss connect sources.
recommendedImprovements.impact: CSP provides less containment if another injection defect is introduced.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Adopt nonces/hashes and explicit connect origins incrementally.

recommendedImprovements.title: Add conflict detection to ordinary admin edits
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Running schema has zero rowversion columns and EF has no concurrency tokens; nonfinancial edits are last-write-wins.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Two administrators can silently overwrite catalog/settings/content changes.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Add rowversion or explicit UpdatedAt preconditions to high-value admin aggregates.

recommendedImprovements.title: Generalize secret storage and masking
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Only SMS API key/default line are classified as secret; payment configuration is stored in generic Settings and production docs also rely on environment variables.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Credentials/config can be exposed to more administrators or copied into database backups.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Keep credentials outside generic settings and use a shared secret-classification policy.

recommendedImprovements.title: Add media lifecycle and orphan cleanup
recommendedImprovements.evidence: DB rows and local public/private files are not transactionally coupled and no reference garbage collector was found.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Deleted/replaced content consumes storage; manual cleanup can remove referenced files.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Track file assets or run safe mark-and-sweep with quarantine and audit.

recommendedImprovements.title: Complete retention and alert routing
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Audit/security cleanup exists, but ErrorLogs DB retention and an executed alert/on-call destination were not found.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Operational tables can grow and critical events may remain dashboard-only.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Define retention per data class and connect tested alerts for payment, worker, security and backup failures.

recommendedImprovements.title: Coupon merchandising controls are limited
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Coupons support date/global/per-user/min/fixed/percentage limits but no product/category scope or maximum percentage discount.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Promotions cannot be safely targeted and percentage exposure cannot be capped by amount.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Add only if required by launch promotions; keep evaluation transactional.

recommendedImprovements.title: SEO quality operations are incomplete
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Technical metadata is strong, but BlogPosting depth, pagination addressability, duplicate metadata and broken-link reports are absent.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Content quality and crawl efficiency can degrade unnoticed.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Add content QA reports and finish structured data/query-addressable pagination.

recommendedImprovements.title: Repository documentation contains stale claims
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Root README says automated tests are absent and Web should not be edited despite extensive current tests and UI development; E2E docs contain older caveats.
recommendedImprovements.impact: New engineers and operators follow incorrect setup and ownership guidance.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Make the release gate, architecture, supported database and production runbooks the canonical README path.

recommendedImprovements.title: Warnings and package maintenance are not enforced
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Clean build reports 12 CS8618 warnings; no TreatWarningsAsErrors/analyzer policy exists; AutoMapper 16 is paired with legacy AutoMapper.Extensions.Microsoft.DependencyInjection 12.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Incremental builds can hide warnings and redundant/old dependencies complicate upgrades.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Fix nullability, remove redundant DI extension if verified, and enable analyzers/warnings-as-errors incrementally.

recommendedImprovements.title: Tests contain waits and shared-state coupling
recommendedImprovements.evidence: Playwright has 250/300/400 ms waits, integration has a 200 ms delay, CI retries once, and visual outcomes differ by project grouping.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Timing and order can hide defects or create false failures.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Wait on observable state and give each mutable suite/project isolated data.

recommendedImprovements.title: Load and long-running Blazor tests are not part of the gate
recommendedImprovements.evidence: k6 profiles exist but k6 was unavailable; no circuit memory, provider latency, throughput or soak result was present.
recommendedImprovements.impact: Capacity and memory behavior under realistic concurrent customers is unknown.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Execute checked-in profiles and publish capacity limits before marketing traffic.

recommendedImprovements.title: Payment result and pending-order recovery rely on query state
recommendedImprovements.evidence: PaymentResult renders success and clears cart when Paid=1 from the URL; browser refresh/retry has no server-derived pending-order resume workflow.
recommendedImprovements.impact: A crafted URL can mislead a customer or clear local cart state, and interrupted checkouts are confusing.
recommendedImprovements.recommendation: Load the owner-scoped order/payment status from the server and expose safe retry/resume actions.

optionalFeatures.title: Guest cart and login merge
optionalFeatures.evidence: Cart requires authentication and has no browser/anonymous merge path.
optionalFeatures.impact: Adds friction before intent is captured but is not required for an authenticated digital store.
optionalFeatures.recommendation: Add only if conversion data justifies the complexity.

optionalFeatures.title: Mixed wallet and gateway payment
optionalFeatures.evidence: Checkout supports wallet or gateway, not a split tender.
optionalFeatures.impact: Customers with insufficient wallet balance cannot apply it partially.
optionalFeatures.recommendation: Defer until single-tender financial integrity and reconciliation are mature.

optionalFeatures.title: Partial refunds, chargebacks and settlement ledger
optionalFeatures.evidence: Current service refunds the full payment only; no dispute/settlement entities or reports exist.
optionalFeatures.impact: Complex finance cases require external/manual tracking.
optionalFeatures.recommendation: Design with finance after launch volume and provider requirements are known.

optionalFeatures.title: Product image zoom
optionalFeatures.evidence: Gallery switching exists but no zoom/lightbox interaction was found.
optionalFeatures.recommendation: Add only for products whose imagery affects conversion.

optionalFeatures.title: Admin impersonation
optionalFeatures.impact: Support troubleshooting is less convenient; absence is safer by default.
optionalFeatures.recommendation: Implement only with strict approval, visibility and audit controls.

optionalFeatures.title: Editable custom roles and permissions
optionalFeatures.evidence: Roles page is intentionally read-only and built-in policies are code-defined.
optionalFeatures.impact: Organizations cannot delegate beyond current roles without deployment.
optionalFeatures.recommendation: Keep read-only until real organizational requirements justify dynamic authorization.

optionalFeatures.title: Tax and invoice jurisdiction module
optionalFeatures.evidence: No tax calculation or formal invoice model exists.
optionalFeatures.impact: May be required by future jurisdiction/business structure but is not inferable from the current repository.
optionalFeatures.recommendation: Treat as policy-driven, not speculative launch scope.

optionalFeatures.title: Broader bulk product and order operations
optionalFeatures.evidence: Selection/CSV and product duplicate exist, but broad bulk mutation/import/export workflows do not.
optionalFeatures.impact: Large catalog operations require repetitive actions.
optionalFeatures.recommendation: Add high-value bulk actions only after measuring operator workload.

verificationLimitations: The local SQL instance executed all tests, but its SQL Server 2022 major version was not independently certified in captured output.
No real Zarinpal, SMS, email, DNS/TLS, CDN/object store, Seq alert destination, or external secret manager was invoked.
k6 and PowerShell 7 were unavailable; Windows PowerShell 5.1 ran the repository scripts and load profiles were not executed.
No production IIS/container, restart, two-instance Blazor host, SQL failover, or storage remount was available.
No production/customer data was accessed and no destructive external attack was performed.
Accessibility automation is not a manual screen-reader/WCAG conformance audit.
Focused Playwright runs overwrite the common report directory; visual failure artifacts were observed before the isolated rerun.
